Integrations

Works with the apps you already use.

You talk to Gogo on WhatsApp. Gogo reaches the services your day already runs on, connects only what you allow, and asks before anything that costs money or goes to another person.

See every app

Private beta · The set of connected apps grows every few weeks

Every app

Connect what you use. Leave the rest off.

Each connection is yours to switch on, and off. Gogo only ever sees the apps you have allowed, and tells you which one it used for every task.

Use something else?

How connections work

Permission first, every time.

You switch each app on

Nothing is connected by default. Gogo asks for one app at a time, when a task needs it.

Least access that works

Read-only where reading is enough. Payments and messages to others still wait for your yes.

Every task names its app

Done comes with which service was used, when, and the confirmation it returned.

Disconnect in one tap

Switch an app off and Gogo stops using it right away. Memories from it stay yours to keep or delete.

Bring the apps. Gogo brings the follow-through.

Join the waitlist and tell us which apps you use. We open access in small groups.
